name: Layer-Specific Compliance Assessment Tests
description: Validate the plugin's understanding of compliance requirements per architecture layer

test_cases.name: Frontend layer compliance - NIST CSF 2.0
test_cases.description: Assess Angular frontend security posture against NIST Cybersecurity Framework

input.architecture_doc: Angular 17 frontend: Angular Material UI, NgRx state management, HTTP interceptors inject JWT bearer tokens, route guards enforce access control, reactive forms validate all user input, Content Security Policy headers restrict script execution, HTTP-only cookies store session data, no sensitive data in localStorage, CSP meta tags, CORS restrictions, security headers (X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Strict-Transport-Security)

assertions.description: Should assess at least 3 NIST controls for frontend
Well-implemented frontend should achieve 70%+ NIST compliance

test_cases.name: Backend layer compliance - ISO 27001:2022
test_cases.description: Assess Spring Boot API security posture against ISO 27001 controls

input.architecture_doc: Spring Boot 3.2 API: Spring Security with JWT authentication, role-based access control (RBAC), all endpoints require authentication, input validation on all parameters, exception handling without exposing stack traces, logging of all security events (auth success/fail, access decisions), Resilience4j rate limiting prevents brute force, Spring AOP enforces security policies, dependency scanning with OWASP Dependency-Check, SAST scanning with Semgrep, secrets stored in HashiCorp Vault, database access via ORM with parameterized queries (no SQL injection)

assertions.description: ISO assessment should identify control status
Well-implemented backend should achieve 60%+ ISO 27001 compliance

test_cases.name: Database layer compliance - PCI-DSS v4.0
test_cases.description: Assess SQL Server database security posture against PCI-DSS requirements

input.architecture_doc: SQL Server 2022: Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) encrypts all data at rest, column-level encryption for PII/cardholder data, SQL Server audit logging captures all access to sensitive tables, database roles restrict access by principle of least privilege, row-level security policies enforce data segregation, parameterized queries prevent SQL injection, connection encryption (TLS), strong passwords enforced via policy, no database owner password shared, database backups encrypted, change management via Flyway migrations tracked in version control

assertions.description: Should assess at least 4 PCI-DSS requirements

test_cases.name: Infrastructure layer resilience - DORA
test_cases.description: Assess infrastructure operational resilience against DORA requirements

input.architecture_doc: On-premises infrastructure: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS hardened servers with latest security patches, Docker containers with read-only filesystems, Nginx reverse proxy with TLS 1.3, automated backup and recovery procedures, redundant network connections, centralized logging and monitoring (Loki, Prometheus, Grafana), incident response procedures documented, chaos engineering tests validate failure scenarios, circuit breakers prevent cascading failures, health checks on all services, automated alerting on anomalies

test_cases.name: Integration layer data handling - GDPR
test_cases.description: Assess data handling in external integrations against GDPR requirements

input.architecture_doc: Integration layer: Third-party API credentials stored in HashiCorp Vault with automatic rotation, all API calls use TLS 1.3 encryption, request/response payloads encrypted end-to-end, no personal data logged in application logs, audit trail of all API calls for data subject access requests, data retention policies enforced (automatic deletion after X days), third-party vendors assessed for GDPR compliance, data processing agreements in place, incident response plan for third-party breaches

test_cases.name: Security layer - Cross-cutting controls assessment
test_cases.description: Assess all security controls across the system

input.architecture_doc: Security controls: JWT tokens with expiration, refresh token rotation, HashiCorp Vault for all secrets, TLS 1.3 for all network communication, AES-256-GCM for sensitive data encryption, audit logging of all security events, OWASP Top 10 input validation on all entry points, security headers enforced (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options), rate limiting prevents brute force/DoS, Web Application Firewall (WAF) on reverse proxy, SAST/SCA scanning in CI/CD, annual penetration testing, security patch management process

assertions.description: Comprehensive security controls should achieve 70%+ ISO 27001 compliance

test_cases.name: Full system - Multi-framework compliance assessment
test_cases.description: Assess complete system against all frameworks: NIST, ISO27001, PCI-DSS, GDPR

input.architecture_doc: Complete AI-SSDLC system combining: Frontend (Angular with CSP, input validation, secure auth), Backend (Spring Boot with RBAC, audit logging, dependency scanning), Database (SQL Server with TDE, encryption, RLS), Infrastructure (Ubuntu with hardening, Docker with read-only FS, centralized logging), Integration (third-party APIs with encryption, credential management), Security (JWT auth, Vault secrets, TLS 1.3, WAF, SAST/SCA, penetration testing, incident response)

assertions.description: Should assess multiple NIST control families across system

test_cases.name: Frontend-Backend integration - Security boundary validation
test_cases.description: Validate security controls at frontend-backend integration boundary

input.architecture_doc: Frontend-Backend boundary: Angular HTTP interceptors inject JWT bearer tokens in Authorization header, backend Spring Security validates JWT signature and expiration, CORS configured to allow only frontend domain, API rate limiting protects backend from frontend DoS, request validation on backend even though frontend validates, response data sanitized to prevent XSS, secure session cookie handling, no sensitive data in URL parameters

test_cases.name: Backend-Database integration - Data security validation
test_cases.description: Validate security controls at backend-database integration boundary

input.architecture_doc: Backend-Database boundary: Spring Boot uses Hibernate ORM with parameterized queries (prevents SQL injection), database connection string stored in Vault (not in code), connection pooling with SSL/TLS, application-level encryption for PII before storage, database audit logging captures all table modifications, row-level security enforces application user boundaries in database, foreign key constraints prevent orphaned records, change data capture (CDC) for compliance audits

pre_test_steps: log: Starting layer-specific compliance assessment validation
verify: Plugin understands compliance requirements per layer

post_test_steps: log: Layer compliance assessment test suite completed
summary: Validate plugin accurately assesses layer-specific compliance
